topic: Conversion of base 10 numerals to binary numbers

subtopics.title: Converting numbers 1-10 to base 2
performance_objectives: Convert base 10 numerals to binary numbers
teacher_activities: Uses bundles or piles to demonstrate conversion from base 10 to base two (e.g. 3 represents 1 bundle of two and 1 unit, i.e. 3 base 10 = 11 base 2)
student_activities: Use bundles in twos and units to repeat teacher's demonstration for numbers 1-10
teaching_learning_materials: Charts, counters such as match sticks, broom sticks, bottle tops
evaluation_guide: Convert given base 10 numbers to base two
Prepare a conversion chart of numbers 1-10 from base 10 to base 2
